sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on MusicBrainz: a Barcode cell has a card too — its format, whether its check digit is wrong, and the releases carrying that barcode, from one search; its window lists them (the first 25) with format, label and catalog number, and its Live page is MusicBrainz's barcode search. ← → step down the Barcode column. "[none]" and empty cells have none.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine: MusicBrainz's own td.barcode-cell is a target as it is, no stamp needed; a lookup kind may be fed by a search (query(t)). The search index ignores a barcode's leading zero (probed 2026-10-08), so the cell's own digits are asked.

sections.label: 📝 Docs
items: popup-mb.spec.js: 3 more tests (48) on the host page's real Barcode cells; fixture ws2-pop-barcode-074643190329.json; popup-mb.json: 3 more mutations (44), two re-anchored.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Link previews on MusicBrainz: new setting "Also preview links outside tables" (off by default). When on, every entity link in the page's content has a card too — the header, an annotation, the sidebar, a relationship list — except the entity's tabs, the page navigation and the script's own toolbar.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Popup engine (org/iframe.org Phase 4, item 1b): any element stamped data-mb-pop="<kind>:<id>" is previewed as that kind, with data-mb-pop-name for its loading card; the attribute survives every re-render, and the arrows step over stamped cells as over links. A stamped kind must be one of the registry's own (an attribute string cannot reach an inherited property); a kind may name its own page (a disc ID: /cdtoc/). The coming barcode, 📊 entry and Catalog# cards build on this.
